label: Indicted Baconian mechanistic science as patriarchal domination of nature and women
description: In Staying Alive (1988), Vandana Shiva traced the ecological crisis to Francis Bacon's programmatic metaphor of torturing and subjugating a feminized "Nature," contrasting it with Indian Prakriti cosmology.
dialecticalTension: Challenges value-neutral scientific objectivity as an ideology of capitalist-patriarchal extraction.
historicalContext: Core historical argument of Staying Alive (1988).

citations.author: Vandana Shiva
citations.work: Staying Alive: Women, Ecology and Development

label: Critiqued hegemonic scientific paradigms as "monocultures of the mind"
description: Trained in philosophy of science and quantum foundations, Shiva extended critiques of normal scientific paradigms to show how industrial agronomy erases non-Western plural ecological knowledges.
dialecticalTension: Replaces single-paradigm technological dominance with cognitive biodiversity.

label: Formulated Global South ecofeminism grounded in seed sovereignty and Prakriti
description: Shiva became a foundational architect of Global South ecofeminism, uniting biodiversity defense, women's subsistence agricultural knowledge, and legal resistance to corporate patenting of life.
dialecticalTension: Bridges ecological ontology with anti-globalization political economy.
